lines.text: In the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Paul commands the church to keep away from any brother living an undisciplined life.
Paul's team did not eat anyone's food without paying, and worked six days so as not to burden them.
Paul's command was that anyone unwilling to work shall not eat, and idle people should begin working quietly.
Paul tells them not to grow weary in well-doing and to admonish the disobedient as a brother, not an enemy.
Paul asks the Lord of hosts to give them peace, and he writes the greeting in his own hand.
